events.text: Gap inventory (old hmsc-int studio vs new cart/editor model focus), grounded in code: (A) STAGE: new editor model view has NO ground grid/axes/scale reference (old: 9-panel grid w/ finer center cell + gizmo visible on empty scene). Rendering is host-native (framework/gpu/3d.zig) so the stage lives in Zig. (B) FACE/EDGE MODE LOOK: old studio face mode = translucent per-face tint + center dot per face; edge mode = crisp edge overlay. New editor face mode is visually indistinguishable from object mode. Zig work in gpu/3d.zig mesh-edit overlay path. (C) Player reference mannequin (1.65m) spawn button. (D) Add Shape dialog parity: cylinder/cone/pyramid/plane/sphere/icosphere/lattice + from-build-piece + 16u=1tile steppers (partially exists). (E) Import part from another model (dialogs/ImportPartDialog.tsx exists — verify parity: shape/UV/mounts/pivot copy, paint redone). (F) Save a Copy. (G) Shape metadata readouts: verts/faces/edges/uv'd/mounts + source/groups/fields. (H) Legible UV panel: per-face labeled islands (old 16x16 layout view); new one shows colored rects w/ no metadata. (I) Symmetrize (keep +X/-X, symmetric X) + mirror-edit XYZ toggles — editMesh.ts has mirrorMesh/mirrorMount but no UI toggles in model view. (J) Reference backdrops: drop PNG/JPEG on 6 planes, size/opacity/flip/move gizmo. (K) BUG: Create Paint Atlas dialog renders UNDER the mesh wireframe overlay (z-order). (L) Outliner part rows not renameable (library models have rename; parts dont). User is still enumerating; more to come.
